xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5414: Left column rows: invisible hover buttons truncate titles and meta, Stop × overlaps the Settle box, empty All-deck crumb

plan.title: Left column rows: invisible hover buttons truncate titles and meta, Stop × overlaps the Settle box, empty All-deck crumb
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: In the Command Deck left column, flat conversation rows reserve ~78 px for invisible controls at rest (30 px right padding for the hidden star plus the in-flow, opacity-0 Beside and kebab buttons), so titles and meta lines truncate early. The hover Stop button (left 12px, 16px wide) overlaps the Settle checkbox that starts at x=24; the nested variant's Stop button overlaps its status indicator. An empty All projects deck's crumb reads 'All projects / Conversation' because AllProjectsCrumb falls back to a literal 'Conversation'.
narratives.Proposal: Wrap Beside and kebab in the existing collapsing .conversationActions group, held open (with visible buttons) by a new .conversationActionsOpen class while the portaled menu is open. Drop the flat row's right padding to 8 px at rest and restore 30 px on hover, focus-within, favorited (.conversationItemFavorited) and menu-open (.conversationItemMenuOpen). Move .conversationStopBtn to left 4px and the nested one to left 10px. Render only 'All projects' in an empty All deck crumb. Update mission-control.mdx, DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md and add changelog.d/pan-5414.md. Verify geometry in an isolated Playwright browser.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to nested rows' 22px right padding or single-line layout
- No hover padding transition or animation
- No removal of margin-left: auto from .conversationKebabBtn
- No deletion of the unused .conversationItemConfirming rule or other dead CSS
- No change to which decks pass onOpenBeside; project decks keep the Beside button
- No change to the star's position, size or favorite behavior
- No change to LinkedConversationRow, the project tree, or the crumb for project decks, the No-project deck or other routes
- No pixel-width assertions in happy-dom tests and no tests that read CSS or TSX source
- No skipIf or .only in tests; no allowlist raise for ConversationRow.tsx

autoDecisions.summary: Reuse the existing .conversationActions class for the Beside+kebab group
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names it; it already has collapse/open transitions and .projectConvItem overrides.

autoDecisions.summary: Add .conversationActionsOpen .conversationKebabBtn { opacity: 1 } besides the group-open rule
autoDecisions.rationale: The portaled MenuSurface takes focus and MenuOverlay takes hover, so without it the open group would contain invisible buttons.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep 30px right padding while the menu is open via a conversationItemMenuOpen row class
autoDecisions.rationale: Otherwise the group jumps 22px right under the already-positioned menu when the overlay removes row hover.

autoDecisions.summary: Nested Stop button moves to left 10px; nested right padding stays 22px
autoDecisions.rationale: Nested rows have no Settle checkbox but the button at 18-32 overlaps the status indicator at 28; 10+14=24 clears it. The issue scopes the padding fix to flat rows.

autoDecisions.summary: Empty All deck crumb keeps font-medium text-foreground styling and hides when paneLabel is falsy
autoDecisions.rationale: It names a selected deck, like other deck crumbs; an empty label is as meaningless as a missing one.
Inside the content-sized group it resolves to 0 and does not break alignment; the issue says remove it only if it does.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2. In ConversationRow.tsx (~lines 699-733) wrap the Beside span (still guarded by onOpenBeside) and the kebab span in one `{!editingName && (...)}`, keeping every attribute and handler of both buttons unchanged; the star stays outside. Also add `.conversationActions .conversationKebabBtn:focus-visible { outline-offset: -2px; }` so the group's overflow: hidden does not clip the default outside focus ring.
